freeze_verification.note: run-1 is evidence. It is read, hashed and verified here; it is never rewritten, repaired or superseded.

formal_result.meaning: the preregistered positive criterion was NOT satisfied. Arm B's trajectory did not complete, so the frozen predicate could not be evaluated as specified.

descriptive_partial_observation.meaning: within the partial run, completed valid belief-semantic resolutions produced canonical commits; at least one negative-lived-evidence resolution produced CONTRADICTS; and that commit reduced the canonical credence.
descriptive_partial_observation.may_be_used_as: a hypothesis generator and a description of what the partial run contained
descriptive_partial_observation.may_not_be_used_as: the Phase-0 result, a positive finding, or a substitute for the frozen predicate

scientific_language.why_the_separation_is_binding: the frozen predicate requires arm B's trajectory to COMPLETE. It did not. A partial run that happens to show both predicted directions is not the same object as a completed run that satisfies the predicate, and treating it as one would be exactly the outcome-driven reinterpretation the protocol forbids.
scientific_language.effect_on_future_work: run-1's observation must not inform any character of the rerun's design (no outcome-informed redesign). It constrains nothing and authorises nothing.
